At Blissful Retreat, Jiang Wulang drank alone, as he often did, savoring the silence that came with moonlight. Word of his impending departure had somehow reached the Young Master, who rushed over, begging to be taken along on his journey beyond Heaven's Pier. Jiang Wulang took a slow sip of wine and replied offhandedly, "If you can go, then go yourself." Overjoyed, the Young Master spent the next three days strutting around, telling everyone he met that a new hero was about to rise in the jianghu. The tale, of course, eventually made its way to Han Xiangxun.

When the day came, the Young Master brought snacks and toys and set off with great fanfare. Only to spot Han Xiangxun and Jiang Wulang waiting at the ferry. Outraged, the Young Master shouted that Jiang Wulang had already given permission to enter the jianghu, and he demanded to know why Han Xiangxun was here, too. Jiang Wulang answered calmly, "I said you can go, if you have the ability. But if Han Xiangxun catches you this easily, then clearly, you can't." Before the Young Master could fire back, Han Xiangxun had already grabbed his collar and hauled the would-be hero away. The small boat soon pushed off from the shore, ripples fanning out across the water. Jiang Wulang stood watching as the two figures grew smaller until they faded into the distance.

108698036619752419: Wang Shisan is the thirteenth child in her family, born into a home already bursting with siblings. Her mother fell gravely ill after delivering her and soon passed away. Her father, constantly away working to keep the household afloat, leaves the child to be raised by her elder brothers and sisters. But Wang Shisan is never the delicate, coddled youngest. From the moment she could speak and understand the world around her, she stepped into the role of household manager. Unlike her honest, straightforward siblings, she has sharp eyes and a mind. Trailing behind her siblings as they scraped together a living, she learns to read people and situations and navigates the world with uncanny savvy. Slick as an eel and quick with words, she built connections, won favors, and convinced her siblings to start a small business in the city. Under her clever management, it thrived. But their rising fortune soon drew attention from the local hoodlums. To the Li family of Jiangzhou, the Wangs are nothing more than pawns to be swept aside. One night, without warning, the family's shop was burned down. All her siblings perished, trying to shield her from the flames. Wang Shisan crawled out of the wreckage alone, making her way to Kaifeng with nothing but vengeance in her heart. She knew she had to grasp power because only then could she make the Li family pay for what they'd done. But she had no idea where to begin.
